proof_and_teaching_review: Original cohort selection, open-manager allocation eligibility and final reporting restatement are three distinct operations.
Constant active observations imply zero sample tracking error, not guaranteed return or identifiable skill. Sample factor fit is not an equilibrium price restriction.
Positive-definite sample/prior blend and explicit orthogonal residuals yield valid total/private/manager cross-covariances; baseline bounded law has positive gross payoffs.
Worst mean at the lower overlay endpoint follows from nonnegative manager holdings; no unstated probabilities.
Finite exhaustive enumeration establishes the global optimum within the bounded grid, not a universal optimal strategy.
Capital call is internal investment, scholarships external uses; private accounting value and future payout are unavailable at an earlier payment date.
Sold original units are extinguished once; spread and fee bridge marked value to cash, and later bond proceeds use remaining units.
Target-minus-actual wealth formula includes unfilled opportunity, fee growth and cash-principal timing; no total-pool TWR without private boundary values.
All offered methods are taught in prerequisites or scaffolded in the prompt; no required unexplained Cholesky procedure.

source_review.mode: Five exact canonical previously verified primary-source records reused; no redundant new browsing or unsupported current claim.
source_review.scope: Information availability, covariance shrinkage, full fund histories/model sensitivity, institutional policy governance and fee/flow measurement. No source supplies the original case data, policy thresholds, performance evidence or present legal requirements.
